parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of wood and providing support for shelves and doors.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all other parts together, providing stability and shape to the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports the entire structure.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat wooden panel inside the cabinet used to hold stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the frame, used to cover and access the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior of the cabinet and protects stored items from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or slides open and closed depending on the hinge or track mechanism.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a wooden panel similar to the left door, used for accessing the other side of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right section of the cabinet and maintains a clean exterior appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or slides open and closed depending on the hinge or track mechanism.
